title: MARCUS: Missing-Aware Region Representation with Contextual Urban Signals for Rent Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.18546v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal urban data has expanded the applications of urban region representation learning, such as functional zone identification and real estate appraisal, but also introduces challenges caused by data incompleteness. Existing studies usually handle missing data through imputation, treating missingness as noise while ignoring its potential semantic value. To address this issue, we propose MARCUS, a missing-aware region representation model that treats missingness as a contextual urban signal. MARCUS models missingness in three stages: Intra Learning jointly encodes observed features and missing patterns, Inter Learning estimates modality reliability to guide cross-modal interaction, and Fusion uses missing-aware and time-aware gating to generate the final region embedding. We apply MARCUS to rent prediction, a task with long-term trends and seasonal fluctuations, using real-world datasets from Sydney and New York. Experimental results

translated_title: 马库斯：结合情境城市信号处理缺失感知的区域表示用于租金预测
translated_abstract: 多模态城市数据扩展了城市区域表示学习的应用，如功能区识别和房地产评估，但也带来了数据不完整所引发的挑战。现有研究通常通过插补处理缺失数据，将缺失视为噪声，而忽略其潜在语义价值。为解决这一问题，我们提出马库斯，一种缺失感知的区域表示模型，将缺失视为一种情境城市信号。马库斯分三个阶段建模缺失：内部学习联合编码观测特征和缺失模式，交互学习估计模态可靠性以引导跨模态交互，融合使用缺失感知和时间感知门控生成最终区域嵌入。我们将马库斯应用于租金预测，该任务具有长期趋势和季节性波动，使用来自悉尼和纽约的真实世界数据集。实验结果表明……
tldr: 本文提出马库斯模型，创新性地将数据缺失视为有语义的城市信号而非噪声，通过三阶段建模（内部学习、交互学习、融合）生成区域表示，在租金预测任务中验证了有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MARCUS, a novel model that treats data missingness as a meaningful urban signal rather than noise, using a three-stage framework (Intra Learning, Inter Learning, and Fusion) to generate region representations, demonstrated effective in rent prediction.
